changelog: v1.7.0 — ⚙ Settings: the ChatGPT connection, which cards each tab shows, and the classic job search (switch + editable saved search URL) — the tabs keep only what's needed; Easy Bids fits on one screen. Easy Bids: one label, New Job or Duplicate; duplicates are found by company name too (any region, 15 days, "Acme Inc." = "Acme"); jobs get the profile's region (its region, or its country). A CV's ChatGPT chat stays open so you can ask it tech questions (Open Chat); it is closed and deleted on Mark as Applied / Report / Skip.
